402040101.text: Atashye! I've tried my best to remain calm, but these reports you keep handing in are useless!

402040102.text: Just look at the things you write! "Possibly," "probably," "roughly"... How am I supposed to build a mathematical model based on uncertainties!?

402040103.text: Th—Th—That's... I don't have enough time! Not to mention, I'm from Kshahrewar! How am I supposed to know how to measure the impacts on living organisms? T—T—Take Fungi as an example...

402040104.text: Wh—Wh—What am I supposed to do with Fungi? Do you want me to stick my hand in one's mouth and let it bite me so I can write down something like "Hmm, that is a surprisingly powerful bite"?

402040105.text: Darwish, you're from the Amurta Darshan, back me up here, will you?

402040106.text: Haha, if you really want me to get involved, I'd have to start by saying that your grasp of basic biology is shockingly poor — surely everyone knows that most Fungi don't have mouths...

402040108.text: However, Fadaweh, we don't require an exceedingly precise model this time. Our research isn't aimed at those stuffy old scholars at the Akademiya...

402040109.text: The purpose of this little project is to provide knowledge to children. It's supposed to be engaging. A little imagination is hardly unwarranted.

402040110.text: O—Oh... I see. Well, if you say so...

402040111.text: Hmph! Honestly, Fadaweh. The way you speak to Darwish... You're a whole different person from when you talk to me!

402040112.text: Alright, alright, no need to argue. I've pretty much finished everything I was working on, and I've reviewed Atashye's conclusions.

402040113.text: Besides, the data can be adjusted once the test has concluded. That's the whole point of testing.

402040114.text: A—Ah, of course, Darwish... Clear-headed and organized as always! Unlike a certain someone...

402040115.text: Indeed, indeed... And no, I'm not asking who that "certain someone" is.

402040116.text: Can you two please knock it off? We've got final preparations to make!

402040118.text: And I'll go check if the paint's dried...

402040119.text: Speaking of the test... and test subjects... I don't suppose you two would be interested in helping out?

402040120.text: I mean, you've been standing there watching us for a while now.

402040122.text: Yes, you. Do you want to take part in our test? You'll get to eat all the fruit you want!

402040124.text: Not quite... Hmm. How best to explain...

402040130.text: How about this — I'll start by asking you a question... Let's see... "Who would win in a fight between a sliding Stretchy Pyro Fungus and a Rishboland Tiger?"

402040126.text: Don't say that! You make it sound like we're a couple of passing weirdos.

402040127.text: Maybe we should hear them out before deciding? Paimon wants to learn more about the fresh fru— Ahem, about this project...

402040128.text: Such an inquisitive mind! I'm sure your travels have been blessed by luck.

402040129.text: Now, let me introduce our research here. Hmm, how best to explain...

402040201.text: So, ready to learn about the "Companion Caper Chronicles"?

402040203.text: Alright then, let me just set up the map and game board...
